```{r}
Activity <- model$data$fleet.model$gear_activity

# Power_m <- as.matrix(Power)

extract_nonzero_power <- function(Power) {
  
  # ensure matrix
  Power <- as.matrix(Power)
  
  # find non-zero entries
  idx <- which(Power != 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  # build data frame
  df <- data.frame(
    Columns = idx[, 2],
    Indexes = idx[, 1],
    Values  = Power[idx]
  )
  
  return(df)
}



extract_single_occurrence_columns <- function(df) {
  
  # count how many times each column appears
  col_counts <- table(df$Columns)
  
  # find columns that appear exactly once
  single_cols <- names(col_counts[col_counts == 1])
  
  # filter original data frame
  result <- df[df$Columns %in% as.numeric(single_cols), ]
  
  return(result)
}


normalize_by_group_max <- function(df) {
  
  # get max per column group
  max_vals <- tapply(df$Values, df$Columns, max)
  
  # map max back to each row
  df$MaxValue <- max_vals[as.character(df$Columns)]
  
  # normalize
  df$Normalized <- df$MaxValue / df$Values
  
  return(df)
}


df <- extract_nonzero_power(Power)
result <- extract_single_occurrence_columns(df)
df <- normalize_by_group_max(df)


print(df)

```


```{r}


cosine_similarity <- function(x, y) {
  norm_x <- sqrt(sum(x^2))
  norm_y <- sqrt(sum(y^2))
  
  sum(x * y) / (norm_x * norm_y)
}



print(cosine_similarity(c(1,0), c(-1, 0)))

```
